description: Change a node's z-order among its siblings. position is the FINAL index (0 = back/bottom, childCount-1 = front/top); 'back' and 'front' also work. Out-of-range values are clamped. Verified by readback (REORDER_FAILED otherwise). Children of instances cannot be reordered (INSTANCE_SUBLAYER_RESTRICTED): reorder on the master.
name: figma_reorder_node
